centipede.why: Plural mismatched the singular 'Scolopendre'; regular plural is scolopendres

dump-truck.why: Both noun elements pluralize in the apposition compound: des camions-bennes

guinea-pig.why: Plural must match the given singular 'Cochon d'Inde'; stored plural was a different synonym (cobaye). Plural of cochon d'Inde = cochons d'Inde.

sea-lion.why: plural must match the singular lemma 'Lion de mer' (lion→lions); 'Otaries' is a different lemma (otarie), leaving the entry internally inconsistent

squid.why: singular head is 'Calmar'; plural of calmar is 'calmars' (spelling-variant mismatch: Calmar vs Calamars)

tanker-truck.why: both elements pluralize in this noun+noun compound

teacher.why: plural must match the singular head 'Professeur', not a different lexeme (enseignant)

woodpecker.why: plural must match the singular head 'Pic' (le pic); 'piverts' is a different lexeme

angel.why: 'ange' is always masculine (un ange), even for a female angel

cabin.why: 'cabane' is feminine (une cabane); cf. 'cabana' row correctly f

cake-pan.why: baking mould = le moule (masculine); la moule only = mussel

chocolate-bar.why: Head noun of 'Barre de chocolat' is barre (nom féminin): une barre de chocolat

cymbals.why: cymbale is nom féminin: une cymbale, des cymbales

double-ended-wrench.why: Head noun of 'Clé à deux bouts' is clé (nom féminin): une clé

erlenmeyer-flask.why: Head noun of 'Fiole Erlenmeyer' is fiole (nom féminin): une fiole

forest.why: forêt is feminine (une forêt); masculine 'foret' means drill bit, not forest.

gingerbread-house.why: Head noun of 'Maison en pain d'épices' is maison (feminine).

muffin-tin.why: 'moule' (récipient/mold) is masculine (le moule); la moule = mussel. Head noun of 'Moule à muffins' is masculine.

mercury.why: The planet/element Mercure is masculine (cf. Mars, Neptune both m in-batch); 'f' is the clear outlier.

pinecone.why: head noun 'pomme' (pomme de pin) is feminine

pipe-wrench.why: head noun 'clé' (clé à molette) is feminine

seahorse.why: hippocampe is masculine (un hippocampe); note sibling key sea-horse already correctly m

sea-lion.why: the displayed singular 'Lion de mer' is masculine (un lion de mer); gender f belonged to the mismatched 'otarie'

wrench.why: head noun 'clé à molette' is feminine (une clé)
